caseStudy.heading: An upmarket double-storey, documented from foundations to finishes
narrative: House Venter is an upmarket double-storey dwelling of roughly 550 m², built for client Jacques Venter to the designs of Michael Jack Architects at Royalston, Gqeberha.

The photographs tell the build story: the aerial shows the foundations and formwork taking shape; the finished house pairs face brick with full-height glazing onto the garden, with interiors finished to match — polished concrete floors and a timber-slat kitchen ceiling.
Full project records and photographs are held at our office.
